notes.title: Tactichord Rocks on Down to Malmö!
notes.notes: [p]Fresh off of our trip to Gamescom in Cologne just yesterday, we're taking Tactichord south again to visit [b]Malmö Game Week[/b] August 30th and 31st.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/28406cede426d8f6e7edf223735ecbdaa0e72464.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check us out in the [b]Indie Corner[/b] next to the food court to try out our latest build and win some good really cool merch!  We'll have an updated version of the game with lots of cool UX improvements built out of feedback from our playtests over the summer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/a0e3b123affa9a4dfe30ee3b63f7f941973f7ded.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Learn about tickets and opening hours of the [url="https://www.malmogameweek.com/"]convention here[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Dev blog #3
notes.notes:
[p]Another month, another bit of progress on [b]Tactichord: Glam Strategy[/b].  Those who know, know, but Sweden in July basically shuts down and things slow to a crawl.  This is the month where we switch over milestones, people take long vacations, and not much development occurs.  This is mostly true for us this last month as well, but we took the opportunity to make a few small changes and show the game in Japan for the first time![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/bef00cb854fdb46741d25b843ec9a490dd419167.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the middle of July we were fortunate to have an opportunity to show the game at Tokyo Indies, an event very similar to the Indie Game Dungeon we often frequent here in Stockholm.  We gave a short presentation on the title, and other developers and fans alike were around to try the game.  These kinds of things are always made more easier with the help of our amazing marketing assistant Shinta, who lives near Tokyo.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/2531f9efbbeb19398005c9f9f34d42cfe181ce2a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There have been some small improvements to the UI in Tactichord as part of our larger core experience improvement we've been working on based on feedback from the last few playtests, but we'll save those GIFs and explanations for a future dev blog.[/p][p]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/f333be5e02093e4d6bc492f9732c8d9388cdac46.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What we can talk about is some tangential news related to the seminal rhythm title for Nintendo DS, [i]Osu! Tatakae! Ouendan[/i].  July was the twentieth anniversary of the Japanese cheerleading game's release and our creative director David was a part of the small indie team that created to the title.  There is a lot of [i]Ouendan[/i] in the spirit and delivery of [i]Tactichord, [/i]so fans of the former have a few little surprises to look forward to.  Along with lead artist Atsushi Saito and lead engineer Norhide Okada, David was interviewed by Retro Gamer magazine for a six page article covering the making of Ouendan.   If you've ever played [i]Elite Beat Agents[/i] or the fan game [i]osu![/i], this is where it all began.  You can order a copy of the Retro Gamer July 2025 edition from a number of resellers online.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/94b99d4d4d1cf3e65e4b70ccfdd713b41faeb0b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thirsty for more? You can be a part of our micro- dev logos in our very own [b]studio Discord[/b]! Share ideas of [i]Backbeat[/i] universe lore with other players, learn about upcoming events and campaigns, and let us know what you think about the evolving look and style of the game.

[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FVFVF8aBzwM"]Click here to reach the Discord![/url]

Next up, Gamescom![/p][p]/David[/p]

notes.title: Tactichord travels to Japan!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/7b8f7a5155c87a2e8d2e3614ef6ed90a76fba4ca.png"][/img][/p][p]It's finally summer!  The office is closed!  It's time for vacation... kind of.[/p][p][/p][p]Things in Sweden have ground to a halt, as they always do in July.  I'm travelling to Japan for a little bit of holiday, biking in the Kanto area and thinking deep thoughts.  But it just so happens the Japanese game meetup [b]Tokyo Indies is having an event and I'll be in the area[/b] so this is a great chance to collect even more feedback on our core game loop and see how it's landing with people.  So if live in Tokyo this is just chance to try out Tactichord before anyone else in your country![/p][p][/p][p]Our man in Japan Shinta and I will be giving a tiny presentation at [b]Tokyo Indies at Mogra in Akihabara Wednesday the 16th from 19:00-[/b].  Stop by and say you read this dev blog and I will personally give you a commemorative Backbeat pin and a big yoroshikuonegaishimasu![/p][p][/p][p]Get all the details about Tokyo Indies here: [url="https://www.tokyoindies.com/"]https://www.tokyoindies.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Dev blog #2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Tactichord: Glam Strategy [/b]has been seeing a lot of playtests!  Since May, we've shown the game three times gathering feedback on the core game loop and finding ways to improve things and make our unique twists on the turn-based tactics genre even clearer.  First, we showed the game on the Moderskeppet Gaming cruise from Stockholm, joining a handful of other indies and some excellent live game music performances including one by game orchestra Songs From Our Savefiles.  We even got Cloud Strife from Final Fantasy to give the game a try!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/a15198fe0bd6fce971e2507a55014e82373da74b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Next we collaborated with the monthly Stockholm chiptune club event [b]Syntax Error[/b] for a special Indie Night literally down the street on Hornsgatan. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/d7a3bd8a06544dcc33dc2b1643e6afcef07c5abc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we joined the long running [b]Indie Game Dungeon[/b] for a final test before summer break, also conveniently located on our home turf of Södermalm.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/7591eadcfb383f7f3ad4ab4c966c2f91f87a0f70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In between all these shows we've also been preparing a Japanese localization of the prototype while also working on the band costume and drummer replacement system.  Shown here is the elusive fan favorite drummer substitute, MPG.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/ed8c10f1e60229063e6ab1e72adfb6bdddff099b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And we got some kick ass lighting and thunder SFX together for the characters' special attack transitions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/dbce592f2af3503e46af12526959925ef46b000f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thirsty for more? You can be a part of our micro- dev logos in our very own [b]studio Discord[/b]! Share ideas of Backbeat universe lore with other players, learn about upcoming events and campaigns, and let us know what you think about the evolving look and style of the game. 

[url="https://discord.gg/VFVF8aBzwM"]Click here to reach the Discord![/url]

Have a great summer![/p][p]/David[/p]

notes.title: Dev blog #1
notes.notes:
[b]Tactichord: Glam Strategy [/b]progress is rolling along!  We've been following the stars and traversing that wasteland of game development between first playable and vertical slice.  The game is totally playable, but does it have all the bells and whistles to represent the core game loop?  Not just yet.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/11813619ee64b19422eed70ea45cf01544ebee65.png[/img]

Since announcing in January, we've been plugging away on a score of things, working both lengthwise to fill out content needed for the eventual demo, and also improving the core battle experience.  To talk about everything we've done would be exhaustive so I'll stick to a few highlights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/793a6f73b5d485d1e35ab9f647cf8bd5bee3649f.png[/img]

[b]Character art[/b] is dropping into place, not only our heroes but the enemies they run up against.  Witness the transformation of a crotchety music hater into a hard core hair metal fan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/e4ca11d13e15a72adc9cee394101ef7ec9ebf2fb.gif[/img]

There are three main musical themes peppered through the first six levels of the game, though each battle has a different arrangement and the[b] riffing style, lyrics, and guitar solos are chosen by the player[/b], creating a number of possible songs to suit all kinds of discerning tastes.  Each song has two complete sets of lyrics set around a particular theme, and every turn of battle you can choose either a rhyming couplet or a sick guitar solo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/4cabc264cd7e3e901d8ed882a96add08d3af709e.gif[/img]

After completing a level you're treated to a highlight reel of your adventures converting music haters into hardcore metal fans.  [b]Camera zooms, dolly shots, and solarization[/b] are some of the effects tied to different game events to help stitch together a unique music video of a band on the run.

Thirsty for more? You can be a part of our micro- dev logos in our very own [b]studio Discord[/b]! Share ideas of Backbeat universe lore with other players, learn about upcoming events and campaigns, and let us know what you think about the evolving look and style of the game.

notes.title: Tactichord sets sail on the high seas with Moderskeppet: Gaming!
notes.notes:
Ahoy mateys! Are ye lusting for a taste of our upcoming tactical starlet and the salty smell of the high seas?  Then ye are welcome aboard the Moderskeppet Gaming cruise May 15-16.  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/ab5bda2cb0de05248d5d43b007be724c99dc0170.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/9b7c294271038554c5c01aa8203b808d8e3a99c2.png[/img][/url]

Next week we are joining Swedish promoters Geeks AB on their cruise from Stockholm.  The chartered Viking Line boat will be filled with music, events, and most importantly, indie games!  Tactichord will have its first public play test in the indie gaming area of the ship on the 10th deck.  This is a big step forward for us as up until now we've been doing exclusively play testing with other game devs in town.

Learn more about Moderskeppet (in Swedish): https://moderskeppet.geeks.se/gaming/

notes.title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy is coming!
notes.notes:
Hell-o headbangers! We're so glad to be able to announce our new game after keeping our lips sealed for around a year! If you're looking for a nostalgic trip through 80s hair metal with a tactical twist, you've come to the right place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/c4978f17ca0146dc24d6be03dfcf20fbd1d0f5fe.png[/img]

[b]Tactichord: Glam Strategy[/b] is our third title, after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1585730/Backbeat/]Backbeat[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396140/Hexagroove_Tactical_DJ/]Hexagroove: Tactical DJ[/url], and a game that mashes up our unique take on turn-based tactics with the dream of prancing about on stage in spandex and going through three cans of hair spray every morning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458514/0d99564d9e7822c11c48b053b227f187ef80f17b.gif[/img]

Feel free to drop us a line on our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ichigoichiegames.bsky.social]social[/url] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ichigoichiegames]media[/url] or even better yet, visit our [url=https://discord.gg/wGqEQA2CQd]Discord[/url] to check out all the dev logs and daily banter about whether Van Halen is better with David Lee Roth or Sammy Hagar (there is a right answer). If you like reading mail with your morning Coors red eye, you can join our [url=https://ichigoichie.kit.com/80d43ec9cf]mailing list here [/url]to get extra details and behind the scenes sneak peeks!

Check out the reveal trailer: 
[previewyoutube=1uU16U7C0dQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Let's get rocked![/b]
// The Ichigoichie Team
